slug: 2024-01-01 Lesotho — RFP for NISSA social registry and MISSA

facts.fact: The Ministry of Gender, Youth and Social Development, with EU financing and UNICEF technical assistance, issued a Request for Proposals for the NISSA social registry and MISSA, closing 12 August 2024.
